posts.author: Kaveh
posts.content_md:
For me, this one the best talk of the conference. A real application of the microscopic detail that holograms can record. If you haven't listened to this recording, I would recommend it.

Unfortunately there was a communication error, and the paper didn't get printed in the proceedings, but then again we put it up for everyone to see, that it was a readers' gain.
